description: Archie Studio default capability — native filesystem (the TauriFsBridge surface) + folder dialog, scoped to the app-data dir and the user's home. Opener is scoped to exactly the URLs the app opens (Archie-2139): github.com (device login, commit, settings/pages), *.github.io (the published site), docs.github.com (the custom-domain guide) — never https://**.
